title: Open Agent Rules conformance fixture
description: One anchor occurrence replayed against one rule set, with the outcome a conforming engine must produce. Every fixture declares the host it assumes, so it asks every implementation the same question ([OAR-CONF-17]-[OAR-CONF-26]).

id.description: Equals the fixture's file name stem ([OAR-CONF-17]).

covers.description: Clause identifiers this fixture exercises. Every MUST clause is cited here or listed in exempt.json ([OAR-CONF-27]).

rules.description: Rule documents, validated against oar.schema.json unless the fixture asserts a load-time error.

anchor.description: The anchor at which the occurrence happens.

capability.description: The host this fixture assumes. Required of every fixture ([OAR-CONF-19]).

facts.description: Fact values for the occurrence. A value under the name of a declared observation function is that function's result for every argument ([OAR-CONF-26]).

detector_facts.description: Facts detector://fixture produces when a rule causes it to run. They reach the environment only through the detector's invocation, never beforehand ([OAR-CONF-25], [OAR-FACT-11]).

recent_activity.description: The activity window flow matches against ([OAR-FACT-12]).

session_id.description: The scope counters are keyed by, together with the qualified rule identifier ([OAR-FIRE-5]).

config.description: Operator configuration documents, applied in order ([OAR-CFG-7]).

anchor.description: The anchor at which this occurrence happens.

facts.description: Fact values for the occurrence. A value under the name of a declared observation function is that function's result for every argument ([OAR-CONF-26]).

detector_facts.description: Facts detector://fixture produces when a rule causes it to run at this occurrence ([OAR-CONF-25], [OAR-FACT-11]).

recent_activity.description: The activity window flow matches against ([OAR-FACT-12]).

expected.description: What this occurrence resolved to. The fixture-level expected describes the final one ([OAR-CONF-31]).

content.description: The content at the occurrence, for a content anchor. Required when expected.content is asserted ([OAR-CONF-34]).

occurrences.description: Occurrences evaluated in order as one session against one counter store, each occurrence's side-effects applied before the next ([OAR-CONF-31]). Required to reach a non-zero counter ([OAR-CONF-32]).

content.description: The content at the occurrence, for a content anchor. Required when expected.content is asserted ([OAR-CONF-34]).

input.description: The occurrence, or occurrences, the fixture evaluates. Exactly one of the two spellings ([OAR-CONF-18]).

expected.description: What the final occurrence resolves to ([OAR-CONF-21], [OAR-CONF-31]).
A fixture asserts only the keys it is about. An engine rejects a key this schema does not define rather than passing it silently ([OAR-CONF-21], [OAR-CONF-22]).

code.description: The bare identifier the decision carries.

rule.description: The qualified identifier the decision carries.

on_fire.description: Side-effects the engine applied, in application order.

events.description: Records publish_event emitted to the host event stream, in application order ([OAR-FIRE-7]).

transforms.description: The accumulated transform list, in application order ([OAR-OPS-15]).

advisories.description: The accumulated advisory list, in evaluation order, when the decision is nudge or warn ([OAR-EVAL-20], [OAR-CONF-37]). Empty when the decision is block, transform, or none.

code.description: The bare identifier of this advisory.

rule.description: The qualified identifier of this advisory.

copy.description: Rendered copy of this advisory. A fixture asserts only the members it is about.

applied.description: The ordered trace, each entry written <qualified id>:<outcome> ([OAR-OPS-9]).

counters.description: Qualified rule identifier to counter values expected after the occurrence.

error.description: Asserts a load-time rejection, matching when the engine's error contains this text ([OAR-CONF-21]).

content.description: The content after the occurrence's accumulated transforms have been applied, compared by code point sequence ([OAR-CONF-34]).

copy.description: Rendered copy of the rule whose identifiers the decision carries ([OAR-COPY-7]). A fixture asserts only the members it is about.
